releaseStatus.note: Available through the normal public updater feed. The macOS app exports and owns RAV's canonical .riv UTI with Viewer/Owner rank and the supplied document icon.

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV desktop Rive animation viewer. The public 2.4.4 release exports and owns the canonical macOS .riv UTI with Viewer/Owner rank and the supplied icon, while retaining authored ViewModel list labels, embedded-image controls, overflow-safe canvas centering, safe runtime 2.39.2 by default, standalone export, dedicated Windows document icons, and event inspection.
